title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas state, fluxes, and Reynolds-derived viscosity are implemented/described.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader, mixed-element geometry, faces, centers, volumes and graph structures are present in source.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.hpp computes face residual and global reductions; checkpoint histories exist but no independent conservation run or production-binary binding was established.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Roe/Harten-Hyman and Rusanov implementations exist. output.hpp always identifies Roe even when --rusanov selects Rusanov, so metadata fidelity is defective.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Source has farfield/slip/no-slip branches; output.hpp:86–87 writes explicit zero wall velocities, and recovered checkpoint surface.csv files are available. This verifies output semantics, not physical wall resolution.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruction.hpp implements least-squares gradients and limiter; main.cpp:167–170 forces first-order transient, disclosed by report.tex:159–160. Steady first-order startup switch depends on runtime options.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen-style limiter plus density/pressure fallback/revert logic is present.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.hpp:596–610 computes full viscous traction, including normal stress, in reported force split; rubric requires tangential skin friction. Numerical viscous results and negative M2 viscous drag are independently limited.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS-like sweeps and case CFL controls are present; checkpoint steady cases stopped at 5000 or 20000 steps, with mixed residual reduction and source unconditionally labeling budget exhaustion converged.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:280–329 implements BDF2 inner structure; recovered Re200 records five inner iterations and final ratio0.915 vs 0.001. Report.tex:159–160 says five, but :172 says one; binary is unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: 6148b7b main.cpp:105–137 constructs a full mesh on every rank, holds it through solver loops and uses it again :409; TASK.md:46,227 prohibit this despite actual METIS and neighbor halos. Historic rank packages require further review.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
